description:
Names of colorants carrying a Colour Index International constitution ID, as recorded by Wikidata.  `strip_product_families` removes a label when several on the same object share a leading token and end in a free-standing designation, and dye names have exactly that shape: `Ponceau 4R` and `Brilliant Scarlet 3R` are names, `Acetoquinone Blue R` and `Accosperse Hansa Yellow G` are products, and nothing in the string says which. Shape cannot decide it, so a register does.

This file is the part of that register which is public. Colour Index International itself is subscription-only, and it is the only complete list; ChEBI is consulted at run time for the same purpose and is checked first. Between them they vouch for 13 of the 8,342 labels the rule removes from the current build -- including `Ponceau 4R`, `Tween 20`, `Tween 60`, `Polysorbate 20`, `Laureth 4` and `Laureth 9`, every one a name rather than a product.

Known gap: `Methyl Violet 10B` appears in no open register, ChEBI or Wikidata, and is not exempt here. It survives the current build only because crystal violet carries 96 alternative labels, four short of MIN_OBJECT_LABELS. A string in that position belongs in `altlabel-keep-list.json`, which takes one curated value and a mandatory comment.

source.name: Wikidata
source.detail: English rdfs:label and skos:altLabel of every item carrying P2027
source.query: SELECT ?item ?name WHERE { ?item wdt:P2027 ?ci . { ?item rdfs:label ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") } UNION { ?item skos:altLabel ?name . FILTER(LANG(?name)="en") } }
